items.source: If this method returns false, the methods on the given class will not get traversed for CacheOperationSource.getCacheOperations(Method, Class) introspection. Returning false is therefore an optimization for non-affected classes, whereas true simply means that the class needs to get fully introspected for each method on the given class individually.
items.translation: 如果此方法返回 `false`，则不会针对给定类上的方法执行 `CacheOperationSource.getCacheOperations(Method, Class)` 内省。因此，返回 `false` 是对不受影响类的优化，而返回 `true` 仅表示需要针对给定类上的每个方法单独进行完全内省。
